bugs.title: Series metadata validation is too strict/brittle — fix root cause (prompt ambiguity) and make validator recoverable (safe auto-correct of durable-request fields, clearer errors for ambiguous ones); do NOT just delete the safety check
bugs.notes: Verified a prior session's pushed commits a51204d/4ea7cdd/d8e15bd/7ca0135 constitute a complete, correct fix. Root cause: prompt.py SERIES_DIRECTIVE now states current part unambiguously and forbids copying part numbers from continuity text; series.js buildSeriesContext emits "Prior events (Part N):" instead of bare "Part N:"; fallback in prompt.py line ~1322 also reworded; series_id restated next to the production.json field spec. Recoverable failure: new pipeline/stage_b/series_reconcile.py auto-corrects series_id/part/start_seconds (both nested and flat shapes) from the durable stage-a-request.json with a logged change list, wired into stage-b.yml before the residual hard cross-check; end_seconds and non-metadata fields are never auto-corrected and still hard-fail with the expected value in the error. Tests: 42 passed across test_series.py, test_stage_b_series_reconcile.py, test_plan_cross_validation.py, covering wrong-part auto-correct (2a), non-series job untouched (2b), correct plan untouched (2c). The 13 failures elsewhere in pipeline/tests are pre-existing environment issues (cv2 CascadeClassifier stub, stage_a network, cleanup timing) in modules untouched by this fix — not regressions.
